archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: Consent Management and Data Protection Infrastructure
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
Automated process of capturing, tracking, and honoring a patient's preferences regarding how their Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is handled.
Example: Patients are classified in system databases according to their preference on the handling of their information; each classification having a set of business rules encoded to handle data accordingly
